title: Rest and Change Service Corner
description: One static sports rest-and-change service corner: complete original slatted bench on the left quiet zone, a full open changing locker at the rear and a complete pedestal drinking station on the right entrance side. Original local POSITION/NORMAL payloads, material dictionaries and internal node transforms retained at unit scale, with translation-only scene placement. One scene and zero new independent models. One continuous scene-only floor with a coloured seating region and an open shared front approach. Not a complete changing building, potable-water system, accessibility route or capacity/safety certification.
